profile.summary: WillianAgostini is a Mid-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in TypeScript and the Axios HTTP client library. Their contributions focus on robust API design, strong typing, and handling edge cases in HTTP request/response workflows. Strong evidence of security awareness (e.g., ReDoS mitigation) and CI/CD familiarity (e.g., GitHub Actions debugging) further highlights their technical depth. While primarily backend-focused (Axios core), their TypeScript-first approach and meticulous attention to backward compatibility demonstrate a mature developer proficient in asynchronous patterns and build system intricacies.
